title: Why the World's Greatest Conqueror Wept | Alexander the Great #history #shorts
description:
Why did the world's greatest conqueror weep? Alexander wept: no worlds left to conquer... or did he?

Son of Zeus, the horse no one could ride, the Gordian knot cut with a sword, an empire from Greece to India and not one pitched battle lost. That's the legend. Fact check: the battles are real, Issus, Gaugamela, the Hydaspes. But the tears? Plutarch tells it differently: the philosopher Anaxarchus told Alexander the universe held not one world but infinite worlds, worlds without end, and the man who had conquered everything he could reach wept, because he was not lord of even one. If the worlds are infinite... can anyone ever be great? Tell me below 👇

Sources: Plutarch, Life of Alexander 2-6 and On Tranquility of Mind 466D; Arrian, Anabasis 2.3.
